scope: Proposition 7.2 of the manuscript “Single-fold Diophantine representations” (preprints/Single-fold-Diophantine-representations-September-24-2026/paper.pdf), one of the manuscripts of result family 242 of openai/math at commit 1581d4cbdd69. The statement is quoted verbatim from the text that pdftotext 24.02.0 (-raw -enc UTF-8) extracts from the PDF (SHA-256 0fa6bf81ce22ef3a), with whitespace normalised, and was found there under this heading on PDF page 17. Text extraction flattens typeset mathematics (superscripts, subscripts, fractions, large operators, delimiters), so the quote can read differently from the typeset statement and can carry characters with no Unicode meaning; the PDF is authoritative. Finding the quote shows that the manuscript states it, not that it is true. AMVO has checked nothing about this claim.
statement: Fix n ≥ 1 and a deterministic counter machine with finitely many states and counters, instructions INC and TESTDEC, and one halt state. Initialize each counter by a fixed choice of an input coordinate ai or zero. There is a finite system of integer polynomial equations in a ∈ Nn and natural auxiliary variables such that, for every input a, the complete auxiliary tuple has exactly one solution when the initialized machine halts, and no solution when it does not halt.
